compare.title: Crawl comparison
compare.error_pick_two: Two crawls must be selected to compare
compare.error_crawl_not_found: One of the crawls was not found
compare.error_different_projects: Only crawls of the same project can be compared
compare.warn_scope_changed: The two crawls have different scope/limit settings; part of the URL and issue differences may come from the settings change.
compare.warn_thresholds_changed: Analysis thresholds changed; some issues may appear/disappear because of the threshold change.
compare.warn_partial_a: The older crawl did not complete (partial data).
compare.warn_partial_b: The newer crawl did not complete (partial data).
compare.warn_limit_a: The older crawl reached its URL limit.
compare.warn_limit_b: The newer crawl reached its URL limit.
compare.missing_disclaimer: A URL missing from the newer crawl does not necessarily mean it was deleted: links, scope, limits or robots rules may have changed.

backup_ui.title: Backup and restore
backup_ui.text: All projects, crawls, settings and report records are backed up into a single .zip file. The backup is a consistent snapshot even while the app is running.
backup_ui.restore_text: Current data is replaced by the selected backup. A safety copy of the current database is taken automatically first.
backup_ui.restore_confirm: All current data will be replaced by the selected backup. Continue?

report.title: Technical SEO Audit Report
report.top_issues_hint: Issues are sorted by severity and prevalence. Each issue lists sample affected URLs, technical evidence and a suggested fix.
report.more_urls: … and {n} more URLs (use the CSV export for the full list)
report.lim_partial: The crawl did not complete; results are based on partial data.
report.lim_url_limit: The URL limit was reached; the whole site may not have been crawled.
report.lim_no_render: JavaScript was not executed in standard mode; content and links created only by JS were not evaluated.
report.lim_scope: Only domains within the crawl scope were crawled; status codes of external links were not checked.
report.lim_index: Technical indexability is derived from page signals; the real Google index status cannot be known without Search Console.
report.lim_cwv: Core Web Vitals were not measured; response times come from a single crawl request and are not field data.
report.lim_structured: Structured data was checked for syntax and basic fields only; not all Google rich result rules were validated.
report.lim_thresholds: Length and content thresholds are suggested values, not search engine rules.
report.lim_orphans: Orphan pages are reported as 'candidates', not definitively; the link may be on a page that was not crawled.
report.footer: Generated locally; no data was sent to third parties.

confidence_reasons.many_errors: more than 20% of URLs returned errors
confidence_reasons.robots_blocked: more than 30% of URLs blocked by robots.txt
confidence_reasons.no_html: no HTML pages could be analysed
